# ASRS-18 ADHD Self-Report Scale

Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale (ASRS v1.1) is a reliable screening tool to help identify symptoms of Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder in adults.

## Purpose

The Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale (ASRS-v1.1) symptom checklist was developed in conjunction with the World Health Organization (WHO), and the Workgroup on Adult ADHD.

## Features

- **Clinically Validated:** Full 18-question checklist with weighted scoring.
- **Multilingual Support:** Localized in English, French, Spanish, Italian, and Portuguese.
- **Privacy First:** 100% client-side processing; no data is sent to servers.
- **Clinical Export:** Professional A4 PDF reports for medical practitioners.
- **Accessibility:** OpenDyslexic font support and focus-mode navigation.

## Technical Details

- **Framework:** Astro 6
- **Styling:** Pico.css
- **Local Storage:** Progress persistence for anonymous users.
- **Deployment:** GitHub Pages
